name: ipscout
description: Ping hosts, sweep a subnet, measure round-trip time and packet loss, run a traceroute, scan ports, look up MAC addresses and the neighbour cache, query routes and the default gateway, list interfaces and subnets, send wake-on-LAN and find the path MTU - from Python or the shell, as an ordinary user with no root or Administrator rights and without shelling out. Ships the python-network-probe skill: the library API, the CLI with its JSON envelope, the raise-on-setup-problems error contract, and the measured platform limits.
